name: Taichi, Crest of Courage
rules:
When this enters the battlefield, if you cast it from your command zone, materialize Agumon.
Digimon creatures you control have Shinka {2}.
Whenever a Digimon enters the battlefield under your control from your library, it deals 2 damage to any target. This ability triggers only once each turn.
As long as you control a Digivice, Digimon you control have vigilance.

name: Yamato, Crest of Friendship
rules:
When this enters the battlefield, if you cast it from your command zone, materialize Gabumon.
Digimon creatures you control have Shinka {2}.
Whenever you activate a Shinka or Warp Shinka ability, tap up to one target creature an opponent controls. Put a stun counter on it. This ability triggers only once each turn.
Whenever you activate an ability of a Digivice, surveil 1. This ability triggers only once each turn.

name: Hikari, Crest of Light
rules:
When this enters the battlefield, if you cast it from your command zone, materialize Salamon.
Digimon creatures you control have Shinka {2}.
Whenever a Digimon enters the battlefield under your control from your library, you gain 2 life and you may put a shield counter on up to one target Digimon you control. This ability triggers only once each turn.
Whenever you activate an ability of a Digivice, each opponent loses 1 life and you gain 1 life. This ability triggers only once each turn.

name: Takato, Blue Card Prodigy
rules:
When this enters the battlefield, if you cast it from your command zone, materialize Guilmon.
Digimon creatures you control have Shinka {2}.
Whenever you activate a Shinka or Warp Shinka ability, you may discard a card. If you do, draw a card. Then target Digimon you control gets +2/+0 and gains trample until end of turn. This ability triggers only once each turn.
As long as you control a Digivice, the first time each turn a Digimon enters the battlefield under your control from your library, it deals 1 damage to any target.

name: Mimi, Palmon’s Sunshine
rules:
When this enters the battlefield, if you cast it from your command zone, materialize Palmon.
Digimon creatures you control have Shinka {2}.
Whenever a Digimon enters the battlefield under your control from your library, create a 1/1 green Data Rookie Plant Digimon creature token. This ability triggers only once each turn.
Whenever you activate an ability of a Digivice, populate. This ability triggers only once each turn.

name: Rika, Renamon’s Rival
rules:
When this enters the battlefield, if you cast it from your command zone, materialize Renamon.
Digimon creatures you control have Shinka {2}.
Whenever you activate a Shinka or Warp Shinka ability, tap up to one target creature an opponent controls. It doesn’t untap during its controller’s next untap step. This ability triggers only once each turn.
As long as you control a Digivice, the first time each turn a Digimon enters the battlefield under your control from your library, that Digimon gains haste until end of turn.

name: Menoa, Eden Architect
rules:
When this enters the battlefield, if you cast it from your command zone, materialize Morphomon.
Digimon creatures you control have Shinka {2}.
Whenever a Digimon enters the battlefield under your control from your library, create a token that’s a copy of that Digimon, except it’s not legendary and it’s a 1/1. Exile that token at the beginning of the next end step. This ability triggers only once each turn.
Whenever you activate an ability of a Digivice, scry 2. This ability triggers only once each turn.

name: Takeru, Crest of Hope
rules:
When this enters the battlefield, if you cast it from your command zone, materialize Patamon.
Digimon creatures you control have Shinka {2}.
Whenever a Digimon enters the battlefield under your control from your library, you gain 2 life and you may put a shield counter on it. This ability triggers only once each turn.
Digimon you control with one or more shield counters have flying.

rules:
When this enters the battlefield, if you cast it from your command zone, materialize Pristimon.
Digimon creatures you control have Shinka {2}.
Whenever a Digimon enters the battlefield under your control from your library, it gets +2/+0 and gains trample until end of turn. If you control a Digivice, untap it. This ability triggers only once each turn.

name: Sakai, Five Planets “Water”
rules:

name: Ami, Cyber Sleuth
rules:
When this enters the battlefield, if you cast it from your command zone, look at the top six cards of your library. You may reveal a Digimon or Digivice card from among them and put it into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.
Digimon creatures you control have Shinka {2}.
Whenever you activate a Shinka, Warp Shinka, Jogress Shinka, or Dark Shinka ability, surveil 1. This ability triggers only once each turn.

name: Kanan, Time Stranger
rules:

Digimon creatures you control have Shinka {2}.
Whenever you activate a Shinka, Warp Shinka, Jogress Shinka, or Dark Shinka ability, tap up to one target creature an opponent controls. Put a stun counter on it. This ability triggers only once each turn.
As long as you control a Digivice, the first time each turn a Digimon enters the battlefield under your control from your library, you may untap it.

name: Nokia, Self-Proclaimed Hero
rules:
When this enters the battlefield, if you cast it from your command zone, choose one —
• materialize Agumon.
• materialize Gabumon.
Digimon creatures you control have Shinka {2}.
Whenever you activate a Jogress Shinka ability, choose one — draw a card; or put a shield counter on target Digimon you control. This ability triggers only once each turn.
As long as you control a Digivice, the first Jogress Shinka ability you activate each turn costs {1} less to activate.
Jogress Shinka {2}.

name: Kyoko, DigiLab Director
rules:

name: Mirei, DigiLab Enigma
rules:
When this enters the battlefield, if you cast it from your command zone, materialize Salamon.
Digimon creatures you control have Shinka {2}.
Whenever a Digimon enters the battlefield under your control from your library, choose one —

This ability triggers only once each turn.

Digimon creatures you control have Shinka {2}.

Whenever you activate an ability of a Digivice, untap up to one target Digimon you control. It gets +1/+0 until end of turn. This ability triggers only once each turn.

rules:
When this enters the battlefield, if you cast it from your command zone, look at the top six cards of your library. You may reveal a Digimon or Digivice card from among them and put it into your hand. Put the rest into your graveyard.

name: Yuuko, Stolen-Avatar Survivor
rules:

Digimon creatures you control have Shinka {2}.

As long as you control a Digivice, the first time each turn you discard one or more cards, Yuuko deals 1 damage to each opponent.

rules:

Whenever you activate an ability of a Digivice, Digimon you control get +1/+0 until end of turn. This ability triggers only once each turn.

rules:

At the beginning of your end step, if you control two or more Digimon, draw a card. This ability triggers only once each turn.
